resources.string:
Offline video analysis

Film one person with their arms and body visible and a steady camera. Front, oblique and side views are supported; hidden joints can still reduce accuracy. Use a local MP4, up to 10 minutes.

Counts repeated arm/body movement using camera-adaptive pose signals, independent of clothing colour. Timings are estimates at 0.1s resolution. Output: 960 × 960 MP4 at 30 fps, with video above synchronized timing graphs. AAC audio is preserved.

If reps are missed, select Very sensitive and choose the video again. If the count is too high, use Standard. Sensitive modes accept less depth and less upward return; they do not assess push-up form.
